Its Denver coinage table for "February, 1900 [OCR misread of 1906], to December 31, 1900" lists silver coinage values $2,014,000 / $820,000 / $406,000 (half dollars / quarter dollars / dimes, column order per the table header). Half dollars: $2,014,000 = 4,028,000 pieces, matching PCGS #6505 and usacoinbook. So Barber half dollars were struck at Denver from 1906 and the mint-mark key needs "Denver - D".
